content: Customer Sneha Roy called insurance agent Anita Sharma at Trust Wealth Advisors to cancel her health policy (HP-883920) managed through DCoders due to a premium hike and poor cashless claim services. The agent processed the cancellation after identity verification and supervisor approval for a pro-rata refund of approximately 4,250 rupees, which will be credited within 5 to 7 business days. The agent confirmed that an automated confirmation email and cancellation endorsement letter will be sent to the customer within the hour.

action_items: Process pro-rata refund of approximately 4,250 rupees within 5 to 7 business days
Send automated confirmation email, cancellation endorsement letter, and refund details to the customer within the next hour
